name: Spike
about: Time-boxed investigation with an unknown answer
title: "spike: <question to be answered>"
labels: spike

## Question
<The single question this spike must answer. If there is more than one, open more than one spike.>

## Why now
<What decision is blocked until this is answered.>

## Time box
<e.g. 4 hours / 2 days. A spike without a time box is not a spike.>

## Approach
- <what will be tried, measured, or read>

## Deliverable
- [ ] A written recommendation with evidence (benchmark output, prototype, or citations)
- [ ] Follow-up issues filed for the chosen direction
- [ ] Prototype code either discarded or explicitly marked as throwaway

## Findings
<Filled in as the spike progresses.>

## Recommendation
<Filled in at the end: the answer, and the reasoning behind it.>
